one_liner: AI meeting recording and note-taking tool that captures, transcribes, and shares highlights from video calls.

auth.notes: Search summary: Grain supports three methods -- Personal Access Token (PAT, single user), Workspace Access Token (WAT, generated at grain.com/app/settings/integrations), and OAuth2 for third-party integrations serving any Grain user. Could not fetch developers.grain.com or docs.grain.inc directly (redirect/404) to capture a verbatim quote.

access.notes: WAT/PAT generation appears self-serve from account settings; OAuth2 third-party apps would need a workspace admin/user to authorize installation. Plan-tier gating not directly confirmed.

api.notes: Search summary states requests need a 'Public-Api-Version' header alongside the auth header, and rate limit is 300 requests/minute. No MCP server (official or community) found in search results.

verdict.rationale: Grain documents self-serve personal/workspace access tokens and an OAuth2 flow for third-party apps, suggesting buildable access, though several details are unconfirmed due to fetch failures.
